releaseNotes:
Feature: Claude Code CLI agent for Telegram project chats (claude -p, stream-json, session resume, queue, Stop, timeout, token usage)
Feature: Driver-based agent engines (IAgentDriver) — switch Cursor / Claude with /engine; Claude model picker (sonnet, opus, haiku)
Feature: Settings → AI Agent → Claude Code section (install, detect, save, test, permission mode, turn timeout)
Fix: Removed the Codex / OpenRouter agent and its settings; old Codex engine config falls back to Cursor
